packageInfo.name: @h4shed/skill-underworld-writer
packageInfo.description: Three-use-case skill for fictional underworld narratives, fact-sourced true crime writing, and episodic podcast production, with PACER-informed fact-checking

characterCreation.description: Create detailed underworld character profiles with three-phase methodology

narrativeArchitecture.description: Build complex mythologies and narrative worlds for fiction and true crime

pacerIntegration.description: Integrate with PACER API for fact-checking real court cases and legal proceedings

podcastWorkspaceContract.description: Canonical cross-agent project/output boundaries, manifests, scaffolding, validation, and release evidence

improvementsFromPreviousVersion: Consolidated generated podcast artifacts beneath a single output root
Added an authoritative AGENTS.md contract for Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Codex, and future agents
Added canonical series registry plus series/season/episode JSON schemas
Added new-series, new-season, and new-episode scaffolding commands
Added fixture-based workspace validation tests and workspace performance benchmarks
Added release-version drift detection and synchronization tooling
Integrated @h4shed/rock-hardened for changelog validation, deterministic release evidence, and attestation

benchmarkBaseline.note: 2.2.0 requires a fresh benchmark run. Generated benchmark JSON is intentionally ignored and should be attached to release evidence rather than treated as a permanent source file.
